content.text:
=== geocoder throttle service full def ===
  cache.geocoder:
    class: Drupal\Core\Cache\CacheBackendInterface
    tags:
      - { name: cache.bin }
    factory: cache_factory:get
    arguments: [geocoder]

  geocoder.throttle:
    class: Drupal\geocoder\GeocoderThrottle
  Drupal\geocoder\GeocoderThrottleInterface: '@geocoder.throttle'

=== Does openculturas_openstreetmap have 'dependencies' on geocoder? ===
name: 'OpenCulturas - OpenStreetMap'
type: module
core_version_requirement: ^11
description: 'Exchange location data with openstreetmap.org'
package: OpenCulturas
version: 3.0.x-dev
project: openculturas
lifecycle: experimental
lifecycle_link: 'https://www.drupal.org/project/openculturas/issues/3507490'
dependencies:
  - 'ctools:ctools'
  - 'key:key'
  - 'oauth2_client:oauth2_client'

configure: openculturas_openstreetmap.settings

config_devel:
  install:
    - key.key.openstreetmap
    - oauth2_client.oauth2_client.openstreetmap
  optional:
    - field.field.node.location.field_osm_id
    - field.storage.node.field_osm_id

=== git remote / branch ===
838d5d0 chore(deps): update dependency ergebnis/composer-normalize to ^2.54.0 (3.0.x)

echo "=== geocoder throttle service full def ==="
sed -n '40,60p' web/modules/contrib/geocoder/geocoder.services.yml

cat profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml
echo ""
echo "=== git remote / branch ==="
git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace
git -C /workspace log --oneline -3 2>&1
